blocks.text: Every letter has two forms: a capital and a small letter.

blocks.md: The capital letter is big: **A**. The small letter is little: **a**.
We use a capital letter at the start of a name: **Amina**, **Ben**, **Cameroon**.

blocks.caption: Capital and small
blocks.alt: Pairs of letters: A a, B b, D d, G g, M m, T t.

blocks.md: Capital letters: A B C. Small letters: a b c. Names start with a capital letter.

lessons.title: Vowels: a e i o u
lessons.programRef: Nursery school English language readiness, Cameroon (anglophone sub-system) - reconstructed, to check against the official text
lessons.author: CastBridge (AI draft)
lessons.source: Original wording, written for CastBridge; to be checked by a nursery teacher

blocks.text: Five special letters are called vowels: a, e, i, o, u.

blocks.md: The vowels are **a, e, i, o, u**. We hear them in every word.
The other letters are called consonants: b, c, d, f, g and the rest.

blocks.caption: The five vowels
blocks.alt: Cards: a apple, e egg, i ink, o orange, u umbrella.

blocks.md: Vowels: a e i o u. a as in apple, e as in egg, i as in ink, o as in orange, u as in umbrella.

blocks.text: Vowels: a e i o u. a as in apple, e as in egg, i as in ink, o as in orange, u as in umbrella.

items: Say each vowel and open your mouth wide: a, e, i, o, u.
